translations.web: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.
translations.bsb: He also made the table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
translations.kjv: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height
translations.asv: And he made the table of acacia wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:
